SF-39 SFI - THROTTLE BODY
INSTALLATION
1. INSTALL THROTTLE BODY
(a) 1ZZ-FE:
Install a now gasket on the intake manifold, as shown in
the illustration.
(b) 2ZZ-GE:
Install a new gasket on the intake manifold, as shown in
the iHustratlon.
(c) Install the throttle body with the 2 bolts and 2 nuts.
Torque:
1ZZ-FE: 21 N-m (210 kgf.cm, 15 ft-lbf)
222-GE: 22 N.m (220 kgf.cm, 16 tt-lbf)
(d) Connect the 2 water bypass hoses to the throttle body.
(e) 122-FE:
Install the No. 2 water by-pass pipe with the 2 bolts.

(f) Connect the IAC valve connector.
(g) Connect the throttle position sensor connector.
(h) Connect the PCV hose to throttle body.
2. INSTALL AIR CLEANER HOSE AND CAP WITH MAF
METER
3. INSTALL NO. 2 CYLINDER HEAD COVER
4. FILL RADIATOR WITH ENGINE COOLANT
